newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares hit record high for Christmas.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares hit record high for Christmas.

text.p: 1710 GMT - Shares closed for Christmas at a record high but with most of the activity on Monday stemming from window-dressing and the reorganising of portfolios.
*The PSI20 index closed 0.29 percent higher at 5,130.29 in good volume of 8.5 billion escudos.
*Traders said they expected a similar performance on Friday when the market reopens after the three-day Christmas break.
*"Friday is going to see more of the same, with volumes and prices being slightly inflated by business related to the approach of the end of the year," said one trader.
